title: Canadian Beetroot Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup that combines the sweetness of beetroot with the richness of creamy ingredients.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add beetroot, vegetable broth, soy sauce, and maple syrup to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
